title: 树下的两把椅子  (Two Chairs Under the Tree)

segments.t: At eleven o'clock, the sweet scent of baking lemon cake drifts into the courtyard while Qing, Mei, and Chen set up a small wooden table beneath the shade tree. Listen first.
把小木桌放在树下面吧，离门口远一点。
好位置。两把结实椅子，朝着花草，别朝着大堂窗户。
给，干净白桌布和两只蓝茶杯。
老陈，你在为中午擦亮挂着的纸灯笼吗？
电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
听听保养大师说的！昨天修热水器，今天修两兄弟！
我修水管和椅子。人的话得自己修。
老陈，你手表现在几点了？
十一点二十分。小美，蛋糕好了吗？
正在架子上放凉呢——金黄外皮配甜柠檬糖霜！
看楼上阁楼窗户：志豪已经换了三件衬衫了！
快去跟他聊聊，小晴，不然木地板都要踩破了！
Now let's go back through the scene, line by line.
把小木桌放在树下面吧，离门口远一点。

'Let's put the small wooden table right under the tree, a little farther from the doorway.' Distance in Mandarin follows 'away-from doorway far a-bit', starting with the separation word before 'doorway'.
给，干净白桌布和两只蓝茶杯。
'Here—a clean white tablecloth and two blue teacups.' Small handheld vessels like teacups—and also suitcases or birds—often take
只
as a crisp everyday counter.
老陈，你在为中午擦亮挂着的纸灯笼吗？
'Chen, are you polishing the hanging paper lanterns for noon?' Traditional courtyard touch:
灯笼
joins 'lamp' with 'basket/cage' to name a hanging paper lantern.
电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
'The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.' Dry Chen humour:
别多想
literally 'don't think much', means 'don't overthink it!'.
听听保养大师说的！昨天修热水器，今天修两兄弟！
'Listen to the maintenance master! Yesterday fixing the boiler, today fixing two brothers!' Playful title
大师
means 'grand master', teasing Chen for acting gruff while caring deeply.
正在架子上放凉呢——金黄外皮配甜柠檬糖霜！
'Cooling on the rack right now—golden crust with sweet lemon glaze!' Kitchen compound
放凉
pairs 'leave/set' with 'cool' to mean 'set out to cool down'.
看楼上阁楼窗户：志豪已经换了三件衬衫了！
'Look up at the attic window: Hao has changed shirts three times already!' Counting repeated wardrobe changes uses
三件衬衫
since shirts are upper-body garments counted with the clothing word.
快去跟他聊聊，小晴，不然木地板都要踩破了！
'Go talk to him quickly, Qing, or he will wear right through the wooden floorboards!' Handy warning link
不然
literally 'not so', means 'otherwise'—go talk to him, otherwise the floor wears out! Now let's hear the whole scene again without stopping.
把小木桌放在树下面吧，离门口远一点。
好位置。两把结实椅子，朝着花草，别朝着大堂窗户。
给，干净白桌布和两只蓝茶杯。
老陈，你在为中午擦亮挂着的纸灯笼吗？
电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
听听保养大师说的！昨天修热水器，今天修两兄弟！
我修水管和椅子。人的话得自己修。
老陈，你手表现在几点了？
十一点二十分。小美，蛋糕好了吗？
正在架子上放凉呢——金黄外皮配甜柠檬糖霜！
看楼上阁楼窗户：志豪已经换了三件衬衫了！
快去跟他聊聊，小晴，不然木地板都要踩破了！
Two chairs under the tree, warm lemon cake cooling on the rack, and forty minutes left until noon. Next time, Qing helps Hao choose his opening words. See you next time.
回头见！
